ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram shows “changes in the coal and iron needed to smelt one ton of steel”; the vertical axis unit is tons, and the horizontal axis has the years 1800, 1900, and 1985. Then reason: By 1985, the coal and iron ore needed per ton of steel had both clearly decreased, indicating that the raw material advantage of iron ore producing areas was no longer the dominant factor in the layout of the steel industry.
